name: Scripts Android Build
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        java: [8]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
        distribution: 'temurin'

    - name: Set up Android SDK
      uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
      with:
        cmdline-tools-version: 'latest'
        accept-android-sdk-licenses: true

    - name: Set up NDK
      uses: nttld/setup-ndk@v1
      with:
        ndk-version: r25b
        add-to-path: true

    - name: Cache Maven Dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

    - name: Install ShellCheck
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck

    - name: Validate Shell Scripts
      uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
      with:
        sh_checker_exclude: "tools/env.sh"
        sh_checker_comment: true

    - name: Run Yamllint
      run: |
        pip install yamllint
        yamllint .github/workflows/scripts-android.yml .github/workflows/scripts-ios.yml

    - name: Setup Workspace
      run: |
        source tools/env.sh
        ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.test.skip=true

    - name: Build Android Port
      run: |
        source tools/env.sh
        ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Djavadoc.skip=true

    - name: Build iOS Port (macOS only)
      if: runner.os == 'macOS'
      run: |
        source tools/env.sh
        ./scripts/build-ios-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Djavadoc.skip=true
